author: smuzaffar
body: Using `fmt::format` via `fmt/core.h` is deprecated since version `12.2` of the `fmt` library (https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/blob/12.2.0/include/fmt/core.h#L10-L14) and requires defining `#define FMT_DEPRECATED_HEAVY_CORE` or including `fmt/format.h` instead. This PR suggests to use `fmt/format.h` so that we can move forward to fmt version 12 and above
title: [fmt 12.2] use fmt/format.h instead of heavy fmt/core.h
